Thanks Samantha — got both attachments. A couple quick items before Finance completes enrollment:

1) Micro-deposit verification: Our vendor onboarding requires two micro-deposits for ACH confirmation. Can you confirm you'll check two small credits (they will be under $0.20 each)? If you can confirm the two amounts we send, we will flip the vendor to "Active".

2) PO mapping: Can you confirm the remit-to line should include PO reference as: PO: REDW-HS-4729 so our AP team can auto-tag invoices? If not, tell us the preferred PO label.

3) Remittance sample: if you can share a one-line remittance stub showing what the explanation field looks like from your side (invoice numbers / PO format), that will avoid misapplied payments.

I'll loop in Marissa from FinOps to process the micro-deposit.
